g.text: Much of what we know is if-then
Conditionals are rules. Combined with facts about a situation,
they let us infer what our knowledge entails about it.
Expert systems: a knowledge base of
rules and facts, an inference engine
Rain and a low sun give a rainbow —
tell the KB the facts, and it predicts.
We can reduce all of this to SAT, as in chapter 5. But following the rules
directly turns out to be cheaper — under the right restriction.
